chapter.title: The Last Waffle
chapter.subtitle: One breakfast. Two egos. No evidence.
chapter.description: One breakfast. Two egos. No evidence. Watch the film, work the shift, solve the House puzzle, and win a fade against the red and blue crews.

tips: Win two districts; you do not need to fill all three.
Start with low-cost cards and leave room for a late response.
You start with 8 Motion and a House +3 Hands edge in the left and middle districts; Red starts with 0 and a smaller hand.
Round 1: Squabble House Manager joins your hand. Round 2: Squabble House server joins your hand. These are temporary copies for this battle; pay their normal Motion costs to play them.

scenes.speaker: Manager
scenes.text: Squabble House. Good food. Bad decisions. Welcome to the night shift.

scenes.speaker: Red
scenes.text: Who touched my waffle? Blue, why you looking full?

scenes.speaker: Blue
scenes.text: That is my natural face. You want me to look hungry for you?

scenes.speaker: Cuff
scenes.text: Eggs still there. Bacon still there. Waffle missing. One feather. We doing facts or volume?

scenes.speaker: Manager
scenes.text: You—new shift. Check the kitchen log, then hold the floor. Nobody earns free food by yelling.

scenes.speaker: Griddle
scenes.text: My iron works. Check the tickets in order and tell him that waffle left here cooked.

scenes.speaker: Red
scenes.text: So somebody stole a professionally prepared waffle. That makes it worse.

puzzle.title: Build the Last Waffle
puzzle.instruction: Rebuild the kitchen log from first action to last. Start with a cold, empty iron and an empty plate. Each action happens once. Follow the requirements printed on the tickets; nothing happens offscreen.

pieces.label: Finish with syrup
pieces.detail: Syrup goes only on the cooked waffle after it reaches the plate.

pieces.label: Pour the batter
pieces.detail: The iron must already be hot and empty. Pouring fills it with uncooked batter.

pieces.label: Lift onto the plate
pieces.detail: Lift the waffle out only after the cook cycle finishes. The iron becomes empty.

pieces.label: Heat the empty iron
pieces.detail: This must happen while the iron is empty, before any batter is poured.

pieces.label: Close and cook
pieces.detail: The iron must contain batter. Complete the full cook cycle before opening it.

hints: The cold iron cannot cook anything. Find the ticket that changes that.
Heat → batter → cook → plate → syrup. The waffle was perfect when it left the kitchen.
puzzle.solvedText: The kitchen sequence is sound. A cooked, plated waffle left the pass. Someone took it after service—not before.
puzzle.skipText: Let the crew explain the solution. The next fade still has to be won to earn its reward.
